title: Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO): what it is, how it works, why it matters, and how to deal with it

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis evaluating how differential access to sophisticated agentic AI technologies could create unprecedented societal stratification patterns and exacerbate existing social inequalities (the "digital divide").

Theoretical evaluation of the potential for autonomous Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO) practices to introduce hidden biases into decision-making processes, information curation, and recommendations without human intervention.
